v.why: With edge 0 removed, node 1 is zero so edge 2 is a dead path and the edit has almost no effect.
Edge 2 receives no signal when edge 0 is none, so the conv cannot help.
Edge 4 reads from node 1, which is zero when edge 0 is none, so the edit is inert.
Edge 4 is a dead path without edge 0, so the conv gives no gain.
Filling an empty edge with a conv adds more than swapping one existing op for another.
Adding a learned op to an empty edge gives a larger gain than replacing an existing op.
A conv on an empty direct edge adds a new parallel path, a bigger gain than replacing a skip.
Deleting a conv on the output edge costs far more than deleting a skip or pool.
Downgrading a conv to a skip costs more accuracy than replacing a weaker op.
Replacing a 3x3 conv with a skip on the first edge removes the early feature extractor, so the penalty is larger.
